parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the cooling of water.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) • Pour 50 cm 3 of the hot water provided into beaker A . • Measure the temperature θ H of the water in beaker A . θ H = ............................................................... • Add 50 cm 3 of the cold water provided to the hot water in beaker A . Stir the water briefly. • Measure the temperature θ M of the water in beaker A . θ M = ............................................................... • Calculate the temperature fall θ F using the equation θ F = θ H − θ M . θ F = ............................................................... • Empty beaker A . [3]

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Measure room temperature θ R again. θ R = ...............................................................
